characters.description: Haven's founder is a hunter, an alchemist, and the Malefic Viper's Chosen.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron, the Malefic Viper, and the head of the Order where Jake studies and develops.
characters.name: Villy

characters.description: Haven's principal administrator and Jake's political adviser.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: Jake's hawk companion and union-oath partner, already a formidable combatant in her own right.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: A Haven merchant and political operator.
characters.name: Sultan

characters.description: A Risen curse expert, Jake's friend, and a skilled dungeon engineer.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: The Holy Church's leading representative on Earth and a gifted diviner.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: Haven's perception-focused inventor, whose machines support the city's growth.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: Jake's brother and a leading figure in the Court of Shadows.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: A veteran warrior and major faction figure on Earth.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: An alchemist of the Noboru Clan studying at the Malefic Viper's Order.
characters.name: Reika

characters.description: Jake's contract-bound elven residence steward and a developing healer. She supports his studies and is beginning to express preferences of her own while pursuing lessons in healing and metaphysiology.
characters.name: Elf steward

characters.description: A senior disciple within the Malefic Viper's Order who assists Villy with an experiment.
characters.name: Duskleaf

characters.description: A dragonkin combatant blessed by the Malefic Viper. Shunned by his original people, he survived alone, became exceptionally dangerous, and recognizes Jake as a genuine equal rather than another political contact.
characters.name: Malefic dragonkin

characters.description: An Order management contact present at the gathering for students from Earth's universe. Irin handles introductions and tries to contain the political consequences when powerful attendees take an interest in Jake.
characters.name: Irin

characters.description: A unique lifeform who arrives at the Second World Congress with overwhelming voting power. The Fallen King proposes a settlement shared by humans and sapient beasts.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: A body-forging fighter who is turning her own limbs into weapons. Carmen asks Jake to help trace her missing family because she trusts his tracking ability.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: The former King of the Forest, whom Jake killed during the tutorial and later restored from the soul fragment held in his mask. Their continuing bond limits the King's advancement and makes Jake a check on his power.
characters.name: King of the Forest

characters.description: A C-grade vampire of the Nalkar lineage who serves as Jake's guide during his visit to their House.
characters.name: Alcor

characters.description: A Nalkar jeweler and former human blood disciple nearing C-grade. Ruby Lake recognizes Jake's soulbound necklace as a suitable evolutionary project and undertakes to awaken more of its sealed potential.
characters.name: Ruby Lake

characters.description: An unidentified many-eyed entity that intercepts Jake in the void and makes him carry an unexplained object for delivery.
characters.name: Unidentified void entity

characters.description: A dual-blade warrior and the son of Puddle Rock's leader. Peter welcomes Jake's group and offers local help in tracing Carmen's relatives.
characters.name: Peter

characters.description: Carmen's cousin and a member of the family group traced toward Paradise.
characters.name: Beatrice

characters.description: Paradise's owner and city leader, a follower of Deontay, and a member of the Golden Road Emporium. Renato approaches Jake after noticing his casino success.
characters.name: Renato

characters.description: The version of Jake shown by the Path of Myriad Choices after a different childhood outcome: his parents die and Caleb is never born, so he grows up orphaned and alone, developing the same bloodline without suppressing its instincts and becoming an isolated hunter with extensive combat experience.
characters.name: Alternate Jake

characters.description: An unknown bloodline-bearing alien whom Jake meets on the Seat's Administrator's Terrace. The stranger appears strong but does not initially register as a threat.
characters.name: Unidentified alien

characters.description: The unidentified alien from the Administrator's Terrace, now recognized as the Chosen of a primordial opposed to Villy.
characters.name: Rival Chosen

characters.description: The green-haired S-grade Hallmaster who addresses the Order's new Academy students. Viridia explains membership rules, recognizes Jake's standing as the Malefic Viper's Chosen, and privately summons him.
characters.name: Viridia

characters.description: Reika's beastfolk roommate and friend, as well as a talented perception-focused alchemist.
characters.name: Bastilla
